angle: Universal Epic Universe’s next major coaster will be an indoor roller coaster, a rarity for flagship parks that usually debut outdoor coasters

title: Universal’s First Indoor Coaster Will Shock Flagship Fans
description: Universal Epic Universe is breaking tradition with an all‑indoor roller coaster, set in the Dark Universe area. The new monster‑themed ride promises a fresh kind of thrill for park‑goers.
narration: ROLLER COASTER IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture the next headline coaster at Universal Epic Universe as a massive outdoor steel beast, but the park is actually building a new all‑indoor thrill ride. On November 5, 2026 Universal announced that construction has begun on an indoor coaster in the Dark Universe land, adjacent to Monsters Unchained, inspired by the classic Universal Monsters franchise, with opening slated for in the near years ahead. An indoor monster coaster will redefine Universal’s flagship thrills for guests.
